_doc: Analyst configuration per control point. name_re: regex on the OSM waterway name; lining: key of N_TABLE in sections.py (set after looking at the PNOA orthophoto); perennial: LiDAR saw a water surface, not the bed; anchor: [lat, lon] manual starting position on the channel (overrides nearest-to-seed); offset_m: chainage shift of the chosen section relative to the anchor (+ downstream); snap_w: half-width (m) searched for the thalweg around the OSM line; half_len: half length of the cross-section (m); bank_search: max distance (m) from the thalweg in which bank crests are searched.

poyo-chiva.name_re: Barranco de Chiva|Barranco Grande|Barranc de Xiva
poyo-chiva.confidence_reason: manual left bank at street level; narrow walled urban reach, capacity limited to Froude 1; the gorge just upstream and the wider reach downstream carry more
poyo-chiva.note: deep walled channel through the old town; houses stand on the valley slope right above the wall top, so the first terrace (street level, left bank) is taken as bankfull

poyo-ribarroja.name_re: Rambla de Poio|Rambla del Poyo|Barranc de Xiva

poyo-torrent.name_re: Barranc de Xiva|Rambla de Poio|Barranc de Torrent

poyo-paiporta.name_re: Barranc de Xiva|Rambla de Poio|Barranc de Torrent

poyo-catarroja.name_re: Barranc de Xiva|Rambla de Poio|Barranc de Torrent
poyo-catarroja.note: engineered channel (encauzamiento Paiporta-Albufera): regular trapezoid ~30 m bed, 6 m deep, lined walls, earth/gravel bed

saleta-aldaia.confidence_reason: inside Aldaia the channel is a narrow lined canal / partly covered that the 1 m DTM does not resolve (0.7 m deep in the DTM); the section is taken at the open reach at the town entrance (~18 m wide, 2-2.5 m deep), which overstates what the urban reach can carry
saleta-aldaia.note: CHJ describes the urban channel as of insufficient section; design of the diversion conduit 80-100 m3/s; ~250 m3/s entered the urban channel on 29 Oct 2024

carraixet-betera.note: wide irregular gravel rambla with old extraction pits; capacity varies 500-3500 m3/s between sections 100 m apart, a regular stretch was chosen

carraixet-alfara.note: section inside the engineered channel (encauzamiento 1991-95, design 1250 m3/s) that starts at the drop structure ~400 m upstream of the section; the natural reach just upstream of the drop carries only ~450 m3/s by the same method

turia-nuevo-cauce.note: Plan Sur channel: ~175 m bed, revetted side slopes, bed in flat treads separated by drop structures (4 m drop 1 km downstream of the section); the reach-average slope is used, as in the design

castellarda-lliria.note: 300 m wide gravel rambla with extraction ponds, no town at the section; capacity is of the order of thousands of m3/s and very irregular

bunol-bunol.confidence_reason: river runs in a 15-25 m deep gorge below the town: no bank crest, the 'bankfull' value is the valley filled to the first slope break and has no practical meaning
bunol-bunol.note: use the rating h(Q); the buildings and bridges at the bottom of the gorge are reached at stages of a few metres

magro-utiel.note: narrow engineered channel (about 15 m wide, 2-2.5 m deep) along the south edge of the town

magro-requena.note: rural valley south of Requena, farm terraces on both sides; first overflow goes onto fields

magro-algemesi.note: engineered channel with near-vertical walls, about 50 m wide and 4.5 m deep, natural bed

jucar-alzira.confidence_reason: lowland river with permanent water (LiDAR water surface ~8 m below the banks, submerged area unknown), water-surface slope ~0.0002 with weirs; normal-depth capacity above the water line underestimates the real capacity
jucar-alzira.note: reach slope from the water surface over 6 km (0.00023)

jucar-sueca.confidence_reason: leveed lowland river: LiDAR saw the water surface (channel several metres deep below it), slope ~0.0002 and level controlled from downstream; normal-depth capacity above the water line is not a valid estimate

coves-alcala.name_note: OSM names the lower Riu de les Coves / Sant Miquel 'Rambla d'Estopet' (IGN: 'Riu de les Coves o de Sant Miquel')

girona-verger.anchor_note: seed longitude (-0.010) is west of El Verger; anchor set between El Verger and Els Poblets
